entities.summary: Pero Fernandes de Castro or Pedro Fernández de Castro, nicknamed o da Guerra, was a Galician noble and military figure of the House of Castro, descended by illegitimate lines from the kings of Castile-Leon-Galicia. Pero Fernandes de Castro was Lord of Lemos and Sarria and served as mordomo mor of Alfonso XI of Castile, adiantado (governor) of Andalusia, Galicia and Murcia and pertigueiro mor of the lands of Santiago.

entities.summary: Pero Fernandes de Castro or Pedro Fernández de Castro, nicknamed o da Guerra, was a Galician noble and military figure of the House of Castro, descended by illegitimate lines from the kings of Castile-Leon-Galicia. Pero Fernandes de Castro was Lord of Lemos and Sarria and served as mordomo mor of Alfonso XI of Castile, adiantado (governor) of Andalusia, Galicia and Murcia and pertigueiro mor of the lands of Santiago.
